summary: Emulator-only source/mode preparation, channel9 JPEG transaction, nominal MMIO services, static-record request construction and first Playback completion compiled into relocatable RAM experiment objects. Other Playback/develop callers, command4 continuation, resource/kernel services, shared layouts and publication lifetimes remain retained boundaries.

rows.shim: Source and mode A32 entry exports and two-word publication veneers
rows.other_side: Queue-4 loop, retained router and machine-1 action callers
rows.removal: all entry callers link the typed owned preparation API directly

evidence.requirement: The relocatable object is linked at the experiment's allocated runtime base; installation and conditional caller receipts bind that package.

rows.shim: Retained machine dispatch, output route, display preset and memory ABI
rows.other_side: Stock dispatcher0x011e8bf8, route0x0064982c, preset0x006d1294 and memory0x0089d908
rows.removal: the packaged composition links the owned dispatch, output, preset and memory providers

evidence.requirement: The experiment binds these services to the retained addresses in the preparation contract.

rows.shim: Queue-4 payload lifetime and shared playback globals
rows.other_side: Retained message storage and machine0/1/11 consumers
rows.removal: the message producer and all shared-state consumers use the owned typed lifetime and layout contract

evidence.requirement: Queue4 serializes entry. Source-bound payload extents stay readable and disjoint from copied destinations; the experiment remains resident over the guarded PLAY interval.

rows.shim: Channel9 acquire, restart, release and descriptor callback A32 exports
rows.other_side: Retained Playback machine5 and submit/release consumers, owned static-record builder and descriptor0x48 IRQ registry
rows.removal: all transaction callers and IRQ registration use the typed owned JPEG API directly

evidence.requirement: Native caller and installed preparation/PLAY receipts bind the transaction and consumer entries to the relinked eight-hook package.

rows.shim: Static-record request construction and first Playback completion A32 exports
rows.other_side: Develop job4, retained Playback requirements initializer and finish/cancel consumers, nested critical providers and subscriber callbacks
rows.removal: all producer and completion callers link the typed owned API directly; static-request and subscriber quiescence permits publication removal

evidence.requirement: Exact whole builder and first-completion bodies use the existing transaction. Qualification separates guarded natural preparation construction from both nominal PLAY handbacks; retained initializer, clear-record release, finish/cancel callers and lifetime obligations remain explicit.

rows.shim: Retained JPEG continuation, resource routing, lock, cache and timer services
rows.other_side: Command4 endpoint reprogramming0x0065aa44, resource1e, reserved lock9 and IRQ registration/release
rows.removal: the packaged transaction links owned service providers with qualified hardware laws

evidence.requirement: Nominal low-level MMIO services are defined in the owned transaction artifact. Native high-level callers keep explicit device-service boundaries; full-system polling and MMIO acceptance use the existing JPEG model. Command4 and status17/24 device behavior remain unqualified.

rows.shim: Shared JPEG request/configuration layout and published IRQ lifetime
rows.other_side: Retained Playback request/completion consumers and interrupt release
rows.removal: all shared-state consumers use owned layouts and IRQ quiescence permits publication removal

evidence.requirement: The runtime and callback remain resident through nominal PLAY and retained IRQ release; unload and post-consumer reuse are not qualified.
